checks.name: 2025년 상장 ETF 순자산 1위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND replace(coalesce(pd_lstg_dt,''),'-','') BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: 2025년 상장 ETN 상장중 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETN' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND replace(coalesce(pd_lstg_dt,''),'-','') BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231'

checks.name: 회사채 만기 가까운 순 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND drv_maturity_status='active' ORDER BY MAT_DT ASC NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, PD_NO LIMIT 3

checks.name: 발행일 최근 순 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE drv_maturity_status='active' ORDER BY ISU_DT DESC NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, PD_NO LIMIT 3

checks.name: 투자적격(서열 10 이하) 채권 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) <= 10

checks.name: 2027년 만기 채권 표면금리 상위
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE MAT_DT BETWEEN '2027-01-01' AND '2027-12-31' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) NULLS LAST, replace(MAT_DT,'-',''), PD_NO LIMIT 12

checks.name: 변동금리 채권 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_bond WHERE BD_INRT_TCD='변동금리'

checks.name: 할인채 목록
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE BD_INTP_TCD='할인채' AND drv_maturity_status='active' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, PD_NO LIMIT 20

checks.name: 월배당 ETF 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_pay_cnt AS INT) >= 12 AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 12회 지급 ETF 건수(분배금 값 보유)
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_pay_cnt AS INT)=12 AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(pd_divd_amt_ann AS DOUBLE),0)<>0

checks.name: 커버드콜 ETF 분배수익률 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%커버드콜%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%커버드콜%') AND coalesce(TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE),0)<>0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_dvid_yield AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 3배 레버리지 해외 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM global_etf WHERE abs(TRY_CAST(cu_lev_fector AS DOUBLE))=3 AND drv_instrument_type='ETF'

checks.name: 인버스 레버리지 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM global_etf WHERE upper(coalesce(drv_is_inverse,'')) IN ('Y','TRUE','1') AND abs(TRY_CAST(cu_lev_fector AS DOUBLE)) > 1 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: ARK 운용·브랜드 ETF
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM global_etf WHERE cu_fund_mgmt_co ILIKE '%ARK%' OR regexp_matches(pd_nm, '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])ARK([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)', 'i') ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 5

checks.name: 기초지수 S&P 500 해외 ETF 순자산 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM global_etf WHERE cu_base_index ILIKE '%S&P%500%' OR pd_nm ILIKE '%S&P%500%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%S&P%500%' OR cu_strtegy ILIKE '%S&P%500%' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_aum AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: 해외 ETF 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM global_etf WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF'

checks.name: 국내 ETF 상장중 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active'

checks.name: 공모펀드 순자산 1위
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master ORDER BY TRY_CAST(fd_nast_suma AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: 공모펀드 순자산 1위
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master ORDER BY TRY_CAST(fd_nast_suma AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST, itm_no LIMIT 1

checks.name: 배당 표기 공모펀드
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE itm_nm ILIKE '%배당%' OR itm_abrv_nm ILIKE '%배당%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN replace(trim(coalesce(sale_yn,'')), ' ', '')='판매중' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: 연금저축 표기 + 5~6등급
checks.sql: SELECT itm_abrv_nm, itm_nm FROM fund_master WHERE (itm_nm ILIKE '%연금저축%' OR itm_abrv_nm ILIKE '%연금저축%') AND TRY_CAST(drv_risk_grade AS INT) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 ORDER BY CASE WHEN replace(trim(coalesce(sale_yn,'')), ' ', '')='판매중' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, itm_no LIMIT 20

checks.name: 2019-12-31 까지 상장 ETF 상장중 건수
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND nullif(replace(coalesce(pd_lstg_dt,''),'-',''),'') <= '20191231'
